messages:
OncallBot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT PAGE  tenant-rate-limits-high: VentureLabs (vpc-dedicated-7) seeing 429s across realtime endpoints. Trigger: 01:17 UTC. Pager: eng-oncall.
Leah: seeing it, joining. getting a lot of 'quota_exceeded' 429s from the dedicated pool.
Priya: customer report: "sudden spike in 429s 3 all workflows fail". They're in EU region, dedicated pool id dp-7.
Noah: can someone post a minimal failing curl or logs? need headers.
Carlos: from customer support, pasted logs: ``HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests\nx-rdwd-pool: dp-7\nx-rate-remaining: 0\nx-rate-reset: 167\ncontent-type: application/json``
Sam: confirmed token-level rate exhaustion. Looks like their traffic pattern spiked 10x from background job. Pool autoscale didn't catch the spike because burst disabled in their plan.
Leah: first mitigation options: 1) temp contract override to bump rate on dp-7, 2) route VentureLabs to overflow pool (dp-9) for 2hrs, 3) apply per-tenant burst window. What's fastest?
Noah: fastest is routing change + short override. I can open a temporary quota override for 2 hours. @Sam can you prepare routing rule and health check?
Sam: on it. routing rule draft:
``
redwoodctl routing add --tenant venturelabs --from dp-7 --to dp-9 --weight 100 --ttl 2h
```
I'll dry-run in staging then apply.
Leah: Priya, pls tell customer we're performing emergency mitigation; set expectation 1530min.
Priya: messaged customer, they acknowledged and opened runbook ticket.
DeployBot: Deploy queued by Sam  routing-rule/vl-overflow -> prod (id: deploy-8243).
Noah: I'm requesting quota override
to support tools: `support-cli overrides create --tenant venturelabs --pool dp-7 --rate 20rps --duration 120m --reason "emergency spike"`
Leah: Sam, once routing flips, watch error rates and latency. If dp-9 saturates, we have fallback to model-variant (smaller model) for non-critical endpoints.
Sam: applied routing change at 01:33 UTC. now shifting traffic. logs:
``
[01:33:12] dp-9 ingress +1200req/min vent_labs
[01:33:20] dp-7 429 rate down -80%
```
Carlos: customer reports partial recovery, sends :relieved: 
Priya: override request approved by ops. Noah, did you set audit note?
Noah: override ticket #OVR-9087 created, approver: eng-ops, note: "temp lift to 20rps for 2h due to backend job spike". Scheduled rollback at 03:33 UTC.
Leah: followups: - make sure logs labelled tenant=venturelabs for postmortem - check why their background job spiked (CS to coordinate) - consider allowing burst windows as plan option
Priya: creating support post-incident followup with customer. adding CS rep Marta.
Sam: monitoring: 429s down to baseline ~0.2% now. latency steady. keeping routing in place until rollback window.
Carlos: Sales flagged contract mismatch  they are on a flat-deduct plan; need finance note if override billable.
Leah: ok capture billing flags. Noah, blamelog and notify security if any anomalous auth failures.
Noah: will run the tenant isolation audit and dump logs to s3: `s3://rdwd-incidents/venturelabs/1823456123/`
OncallBot: Incident status update posted to #incidents-summary. Severity: P2. Mitigation: routing overflow + temporary quota override. Next update in 30m.
Leah: thanks team. I'll hand off to night oncall in 45m for watch. If anything spikes, page eng-oncall.
Priya: customer confirmed full recovery at 01:47 UTC, closing immediate impact. Recording this thread to the incident ticket.
Sam: removing routing after rollback scheduled at 03:33 UTC unless ops extends.
Carlos: noted, adding follow-up item: offer config recommendation to customer (allow burst windows) and run a preflight for their cron jobs.
Leah: good job. Postmortem owners: Leah (ops), Sam (runtime), Priya (CS). Assigning 7-day RCA.
Priya: ack, will schedule RCA meeting and send invite.
OncallBot: Incident page closed (auto)  status: mitigated. Ticket: INC-182-venturelabs
